question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Overture
solution:
The correct answer is '**Preamble**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Overture**: an initiative toward agreement or action; proposal.
 
• **Preamble** an introductory statement.
 
• Thus according to the meaning, the correct synonym for **Overture** is **Preamble**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let's look at the other words meaning;

 
• **Slander**: a false and defamatory oral statement about a person.
 
• **Conclusion**: the last part of something.
 
• **Plunk**: to pluck or hit so as to produce a quick, hollow, metallic, or harsh sound.
